_comment: Snapback Cap front-decoration milestone. Uses the same generic DECAL axis as authored/source_backed/cap_baseball/decoration_evaluation.json (v5/authored.py Decal + v5/integration.py surface integration, composed through v5/source_backed.py's existing render(palette=, decals=(...), lib=...) path). No changes were made to v5/source_backed.py or v5/integration.py. The Baseball four-mark pool was NOT assumed to transfer: cap_snapback's front geometry was independently audited (authored/source_bases/cap/cap_snapback/motif_safe_mask.json) and found to be genuinely narrower at the crown top than cap_baseball's.

geometry_audit.crown_face_zone: front [7,5,12,7] -- 6 wide x 3 tall, narrower than cap_baseball's 8 wide x 3 tall
geometry_audit.finding: cap_snapback's crown top narrows to 2 cells (x9,10) at row 4, tighter than cap_baseball. Every crown_face row-5 cell is diagonally adjacent to that taper's missing corners, so the entire top row of the zone fails the same 8-connectivity safe-mask test that kept 2 cells safe in row 5 on cap_baseball. The Snapback safe interior is therefore rows 6-7 only (10 cells), not rows 5-7 (16 cells) as on Baseball.
geometry_audit.band_notch: front row 10 has a genuine transparent gap at x8-11 (the underside of the bill/visor, not visible from the front) -- excluded from the safe mask as a seam/contact boundary, consistent with the task's 'no seam/contact cells' rule. It does not overlap crown_face (rows 5-7) so it does not constrain any of the three kept candidates.

decal_technique.mechanism: Each candidate is an authored surface Decal (authored/decals/cap_snapback_front_*.json + .png), zone='crown_face', fits=['cap_snapback'], views=['front'] only -- base-scoped exactly like the Baseball decals, not family-scoped, because the two caps' front geometry differs. Same uniform-step 'accent' role technique as Baseball: relief is 0 for every cell so the shifted step equals the crown's own local step, and only the semantic role (hence palette ramp) changes.
decal_technique.geometry: The three surviving candidates (bar, twin_bars, dot) reuse the exact same local art/PNG as their Baseball counterparts -- the motif's identity is the same, only its base-scoped decal record differs. Verified by direct placement computation, not assumed: cap_snapback's crown_face zone (6 wide) happens to centre a <=4-wide motif at the same x-origin (8) as cap_baseball's 8-wide zone did, so bar/twin_bars/dot land on the SAME absolute cells on both caps ((8,6)-(11,6) etc.). Ring does not transfer: its 4x3 bbox's top row lands on (9,5)/(10,5), both outside the Snapback safe mask (row 5 unsafe), so it is an offline geometric reject on this base even though the same shape was Baseball's strongest live keep.
decal_technique.role_and_palette_choice: Tested body-vs-accent Weber contrast at crown_face's own steps (3/4/5) across every palette overlapping cap_snapback's style tags (casual/festival/smart) plus the Baseball incumbent: EMBER_SUN_CHARCOAL scored highest (0.20-0.27) despite sharing only 'festival' with cap_snapback's style list, ahead of STREET_TEAL_GRAPHITE (0.13-0.19, shares casual+smart) and every other candidate (EVERYDAY_STONE_BLUE, SAILOR_COBALT_CREAM, COASTAL_SEAFOAM_CORAL, DESERT_CLAY_TURQUOISE all <=0.13). Chosen for this QC pass because it is both style-valid and measurably the most readable, not assumed from Baseball precedent -- this is only a fixed test palette per the milestone task, not a permanent Snapback requirement.

bar.reason: 4x2 local bbox centres onto crown_face at (8,6)-(11,6); every cell inside the Snapback safe mask (row 6). Reads as a short horizontal accent, same silhouette family as the Baseball keep.
bar.live_reason: LIVE KEEP — reads as a deliberate horizontal front accent at native worn scale; distinct from Twin Bars and Dot.

twin_bars.reason: 4x3 local bbox centres onto crown_face at (8,6),(8,7),(11,6),(11,7); every cell inside the Snapback safe mask (rows 6-7). Two-stroke mark stays clear of the row-5 taper.
twin_bars.live_reason: LIVE KEEP — paired vertical mark remains clearly intentional and distinct at native worn scale.

dot.reason: 3x3 local bbox centres onto crown_face at (9,6),(10,6),(9,7),(10,7); every cell inside the Snapback safe mask. Compact badge sits well clear of both the taper and the band notch.
dot.live_reason: LIVE KEEP — compact badge/logo-like mark is the simplest and clearest Snapback front decoration at native worn scale.

ring.reason: 4x3 local bbox centres onto crown_face at (9,5),(10,5),(8,6),(11,6),(9,7),(10,7). The top row (9,5)/(10,5) falls in cap_snapback's row-5 taper zone, which the Snapback-specific safe mask excludes (unlike cap_baseball, where the same shape's top row was safe). Rejected on offline geometry before live QC -- do not force parity with Baseball; this is a genuine silhouette difference, not a re-run of the Baseball verdict.

new_candidate_considered.reason: The Snapback front geometry does not strongly suggest a distinct simple motif beyond the three ported ones; the task scope explicitly warns against inventing decoration to pad the count. No new motif was authored this milestone.

player_facing_bucket.label: Decorated Snapback Cap
player_facing_bucket.note: Final live-approved Decorated Snapback V1 bucket. Exactly one of the three front motifs is selected; the motifs are RNG outcomes, not separate player-facing variants.

live_qc.result: PASSED — Bar, Twin Bars and Dot all read as intentional and distinct at native worn scale. Ring remains the earlier offline geometric reject because its top cells touch the Snapback-specific taper zone.
live_qc.fit: all three decorated proofs: centre +0.0, top +0, contact 1, 0 floating columns, crown-drift 0.0, bbox-drift 0.0

source_variant_policy.source: plurffle More Accessories and Stuff — Cap (Snapback)
source_variant_policy.closure_note: The source author art has no clearly visible rear plastic snap closure. V1 intentionally preserves that source construction unchanged rather than retrofitting a closure. Future genuinely different approved Snapback constructions may be V2/V3 and may include a visible closure if present in their own source art.
